title: Influence Function and Sandwich Variance for Fitted Overlap-Weighted RMST Contrasts

proof_attempt_summary: Three same-angle proposal versions preserved the exact full-follow-up model, repaired assumption taxonomy, and tried a bounded faithful scope repair. The cold v3 review assigns letter tier below field; independent D and MAIN audits confirm no field-lifting repair within the fixed artificial tail/join class. All theorem statements remain to-prove, OEQ1 is open, and the primitive variance floor is unproved; no D0, Lean/F verification, promotion or presentation occurred.
tldr: An incremental correctness and implementation note evaluates the complete original-record influence and empirical sandwich of the version-pinned fitted logistic/Cox/Breslow exponential Nelson--Aalen overlap RMST contrast at \(L=1\). Its primitive omission frontier distinguishes fixed-horizon cancellation from coefficient omission at every horizon in \((0,1]\), and its finite case-weight identity supplies an observable correction. The exact maintained class has \(C^2\) hazards on \([0,2]\), the stated numerical floors, compact ranges and derivative radii, and constant hazards after time two with matching first- and second-derivative joins. Those exact restrictions are novel maintained benchmark specifications, separate from generic positivity and smoothness. The tail extension is an artificial full-follow-up stress-test device for the pinned estimator; it is not a standard condition or a realistic application model. Its purpose is to make the original-record Cox/Breslow derivative and total calibration fully auditable. All original follow-up enters the Cox/Breslow fits. The primitive variance floor remains a lemma output, and uniform calibration of the total connected ninety-percent interval remains conditional until Open-ended Question 1 establishes the joint Stieltjes and empirical squared-influence closure on this exact class. Generic Z-estimation, Cox projection and learned-tilt differentiation receive prior-art credit. The source audit concerns the pinned bytes and bounded native-R diagnostics; the final publisher supplement remains unrecovered, and no error in it or direction of coverage error is alleged.
gap: The inspected author variance expressions do not provide the complete joint derivative of their own fitted OW/censor-weighted event-risk ratio. Published Cox/Z, RMST and WATE theory supplies the generic machinery. The remaining consumer-specific tasks are its exact original-record evaluation, primitive omission conditions and full-follow-up uniform empirical-sandwich closure on the stated benchmark. This supports an incremental correctness note; it does not establish a generic-method or higher publication-tier advance.
fill: The complete fitted-estimator derivative and finite case-weight sandwich give an evaluable correction, and primitive hazard integrals determine coefficient and full-adjustment omission regimes. The legal witnesses and primitive-derived variance floor remain theorem and lemma obligations on the entire exact benchmark. Joint Stieltjes differentiation, full-follow-up score-tail localization, empirical squared-influence convergence and every safeguard probability must be derived from its existing primitive restrictions. Uniform ninety-percent calibration is conditional until Open-ended Question 1 is proved. The software consumer is limited to the pinned commit and byte hash; source-application model membership and the unread final publisher supplement lie outside that comparison.
